topics.text: The hotel is conveniently located near Yu Village and Mogan Mountain, making it easy to access local attractions, hiking trails, and restaurants. The serene mountain environment offers guests a peaceful retreat with stunning views of greenery.

The staff is often commended for exceptional service, with guests noting pre-arrival communication, travel guidance, and attentive care. The dedicated butler service further enhances the personalized experience.

Guests frequently mention the cleanliness of the rooms and facilities, noting fresh linens and well-maintained environments. The overall hygiene standards are highly regarded, contributing to a comfortable and pleasant stay.

The hotel offers a range of facilities including a swimming pool, hot springs, and recreational activities like board games and karaoke. Guests appreciate the availability of parking and the thoughtful design elements throughout the property.

address: No. 24, Mogaowu, Liaoyuan Village, Deqing, Zhejiang, China
